method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie走出二楼电梯，看见Adam在走廊尽头等她；Adam一直在哭，看起来老了十岁。
facts.anchor: she steps off the second-floor elevator and spots Adam waiting at the far end of the corridor.

facts.fact: Adam说Sloan手术结束，医生清除了一处大堵塞并放入四个支架，但目前仍生死未卜。
facts.anchor: “He’s out of surgery. They cleared a major blockage and put in four stents.

facts.fact: Hattie握住Sloan的一只手，手粗糙冰凉，手背有输液留下的瘀伤。
facts.anchor: Hattie takes one of Sloan’s hands.

facts.fact: Hattie对昏迷的Sloan说自己是Mary，她和Adam都在这里，他会好起来的。
facts.anchor: “Sloan, it’s Mary. I’m here with Adam. You’re going to be okay.”

facts.fact: Adam说母亲因Nick溺水的事从未原谅他，并在Nick溺水六个月后离开了这个家。
facts.anchor: She left six months after he drowned.

facts.fact: 护士来请他们离开（Mr. Ballard需要休息），Hattie轻声告别并亲吻了Sloan的脸颊。
facts.anchor: Hattie murmurs a quiet goodbye and kisses Sloan’s cheek

facts.fact: Adam说医院会搬一张折叠床到Sloan的房间里供他过夜。
facts.anchor: “They’re bringing in a cot to put in his room.”

facts.fact: Adam告诉Hattie是Sloan倒下前自己拨打了911，急救人员约十分钟后赶到，医生说若非他及时打电话就活不下来。
facts.anchor: He called 911 before he collapsed. A first responder was there in about ten minutes.

facts.fact: Adam说Sloan在图书馆时把一个书架拽倒了，可能是摔倒或想起身时造成的。
facts.anchor: He’d pulled over one of the bookcases, either falling or trying to get up.
